First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 15–18 mph: brisk — you’ll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

First group ride? Start here →

About the SVCG Saturday Ride group ride

SVCG Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Longmont, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Varies weekly; Oct 3 start is Bearded Brewer Artisan Ales.

The St Vrain Chain Gang’s road ride, the one that keeps going after the Tuesday night series ends in September. Groups split by pace, and the club says its rides are no-drop except the A group. Routes follow quiet roads around Boulder County; Oct 3 is a 62-mile Masonville loop.
